payload.rationale: This document is a review rejection by Tina TeamMember of the revision to Position_PostGoLiveSoakDurationBasis (the soak-duration position revised from two weeks to one week after the Dockside logs re-analysis). I expanded the position itself (all 12 members including the dropped two-week expressions and the added one-week correction), its parent narrative Narrative_ContainedPainOverUnboundedRisk (60 children at witness depth — the full evidence arc from the initial two-week claim through the Dockside re-analysis, the 'tight not safe' caveat, the formal supersession, Tanya's acceptance, and prior review acts on the sibling sequencing position), and Position_SiteCutoverSequencingStrategy (the contested sibling with its own review acts). I expanded Actor_TinaTeam to surface Tina's full voice across all meetings, then pulled the three Tina expressions from the cutover review that live only under her actor node and not under the narrative: her opening correction initiation (_1), her write-up commitment (_22), and her 'would have come out at Northgate either way' closing (_24). I deliberately did not expand the legacy-archive narrative, the advisor conversation, or the unplaced positions (e.g. PreCutoverDataQualityGateEnforcement) — the '701.06 verifier' reference in the rejection rationale points to the soak-number evidence basis, not to a pre-cutover data quality gate, and those areas do not bear on this review act.

The mainline opens as [a firm one-site-at-a-time stance with a clean soak before the next site ^Expr_1HalyardWeekly20260908_8], restated as [a settled decision to sequence singly ^Expr_1HalyardWeekly20260908_16] and compressed to [the bare one-at-a-time rule ^Expr_2HalyardOpsReadiness20260915_6]. A review adds a scoping note: [the sequential plan unchanged while an adjacent number is corrected ^Expr_4HalyardCutoverReview20260915_10], with [agreement that only the soak figure was wrong ^Expr_4HalyardCutoverReview20260915_11].
